label: Long Sword
note: MH4U endgame LS core is Honed Blade (Sharpness+1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp and Challenger+2, usually with HGE plus Crit Eye+1 or Weakness Exploit on Star Knight/Edgemaster mixes. Only Honed Blade's static +20 true raw and Crit Eye+1's +10% affinity are modeled; Razor Sharp, Challenger+2 (+25 true raw/+20% affinity while enraged), Weakness Exploit and HGE are unmodeled.
